records.courseMatch: general nutrition topics; current syllabus unconfirmed

records.courseMatch: general nutrition topics; current syllabus unconfirmed

records.explanation: Saturated fat below 7% of energy is a historical therapeutic convention among the options. Overall risk, lipid management and the replacement nutrient matter; it is not a complete modern treatment target.
records.courseMatch: general nutrition topics; current syllabus unconfirmed

records.explanation: Approximately 11.5-16 kg for a singleton pregnancy. The selected 11.3-15.8 kg is an approximate conversion of 25-35 lb.

records.explanation: A fruit/vegetable/whole-grain/appropriate-dairy pattern rich in fiber and key minerals. Relative protein/fat comparisons depend on the diet used for comparison.
records.courseMatch: general nutrition topics; current syllabus unconfirmed

records.explanation: Current FDA/EPA guidance: 2-3 servings weekly from lower-mercury Best Choices, 8-12 oz total. A historical “twice” answer must not become an all-species rule.
records.courseMatch: general nutrition topics; current syllabus unconfirmed

records.explanation: Assess and improve the existing diet/lifestyle. Do not automatically prescribe high protein, unlimited nuts or weight loss regardless of the patient.

records.explanation: Iron-deficiency anemia, not an inherited globin disorder such as sickle-cell disease or thalassemia.

records.explanation: Indirect nutritional assessment: morbidity, mortality and social context do not directly measure an individual nutrient concentration.

records.explanation: Tyrosine, because phenylalanine-to-tyrosine conversion is impaired. Phenylalanine still requires controlled provision.

records.explanation: Chronic infection more typically causes anemia of inflammation. The marked chronic occult fecal bleeding is wrong: sustained blood loss is a classic iron-deficiency cause. Coexistence remains possible.

records.explanation: Suitable iron-rich foods plus vitamin C; separate tea from iron-rich meals where relevant. Do not give everyone iron supplements or prohibit all dairy.

records.explanation: These choices suggest a relatively low-fat, fiber-rich pattern among the options. Added fats and processing can change the composition.
